''See also: [[Temporal Field Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|A Temporal Field is a specialized form of masterwork [[Aethertech]] that alters an individual's relationship to time. When activated, the field causes the surrounding world to slow down significantly or stop entirely from the user's perspective. This allows the user to move at high speeds relative to others, effectively granting them superior reaction times and the ability to perform actions while time remains frozen. Objects or people that the user personally interacts with become subject to their movements, whereas everything else remains locked in place until the field is deactivated. While the ability can be enhanced by sacrificing system power to reach extreme levels of temporal distortion, it is subject to certain restrictions. For some users, such as those with human minds, the field can only be utilized in brief intervals. The technology is complex to [[construct]], requiring components like a [[Temporal Prism]].}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The Temporal Field is an [[Aether]]-dependent system used as a [[technique]] to manipulate relative time. This method slows the world surrounding the user and can provide warnings, though it also interferes with camera footage. By realigning a being's relationship to time, the field allows them to move faster than others. Furthermore, anything a user personally interacts with becomes subject to their actions while the field is active. Both [[Sola Kalter|Sola]] and [[Starhammer]] are known to possess this [[technique]].}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Regarded as a masterwork of [[Aethertech]], the Temporal Field is an ability utilized by [[Sola Kalter|Sola]]'s clones. This power allows for the freezing of time around a specific target. During its activation, [[Mell D-One-Twenty-Five|Mell]] is unable to pilot the [[Starhammer]]. [[Sola Kalter|Sola]] herself has engaged this field in order to freeze time.}}
